findings.body: The loop at line 261 overwrites the saved PowerShell executable path with the string `powershell`. Consequently, QUERY_FAILS launches the same wrapper installed on PATH instead of real PowerShell. It never exercises the intended Get-CimInstance error: recursion can hang or fail for an unrelated reason that still satisfies the refusal assertion. Preserve the real executable path under a separate variable so this test actually detects broken query-error handling.

findings.body: Expanding SDK checks and installation to CLAUDECODE implements cold-reader setup, outside this part's locking and cleanup requirements. The diagnostic rewrites at lines 126 and 129 are also unrelated. These changes require unnecessary edits to tests/test_codex_setup.py and tests/test_setup.py; the added CLAUDECODE reset in tests/conftest.py duplicates the existing reset at line 113. Remove those changes while retaining doctor cleanup integration and the lifecycle tests.
